title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Fields Medalists Warn of AI Misalignment in Math: Terence Tao and 24 Fields Medalists released an open letter criticizing AI labs for treating mathematical research as a brute-force benchmark, rushing unverified proofs, and compromising attribution.

Elon Musk Details Grok 4.7 Delay: Elon Musk revealed Grok 4.7 will take a few more days to release after reinforcement learning overly penalized response length, causing the model to give up prematurely on hard tasks.

ChatGPT Sites Passes 5 Million Milestone: OpenAI announced over 5 million web applications have been published via ChatGPT Sites, introducing team co-editing, private sharing, custom domain mapping, and database inspection.

Massive Security Breach via Chinese LLM Proxy Relays: Cybersecurity researchers uncovered a 6TB leak from Chinese commercial LLM API routers exposing SSH keys, VPN credentials, and internal prompt data from top tech firms and government agencies.
Apple Purchasing Samsung Foldable OLEDs for iPhone Duo: Industry sources reported Apple is sourcing foldable OLED display modules from Samsung at $250 per unit for the upcoming iPhone Duo.

items.title: @ns123abc & @Polymarket: Terence Tao & 24 Fields Medalists Publish Open Letter on AI in Math
items.body: Terence Tao and 24 fellow Fields Medalists signed a joint letter warning AI laboratories against treating mathematics as a brute-force benchmark. They highlighted concerns over rushed proof announcements, lack of proper writeups, and potential plagiarism.

items.title: @elonmusk: Grok 4.7 Launch Delayed a Few Days for RL Fine-Tuning
items.body: Elon Musk shared that Grok 4.7 requires additional fine-tuning after RL training overly penalized output length, leading the model to terminate early on complex reasoning tasks.

items.title: @ChatGPT: ChatGPT Sites Surpasses 5M Apps with New Collaboration Features
items.body: OpenAI reported over 5 million sites created on ChatGPT Sites since launch, rolling out shared workspace editing, private link permissions, custom domain support, and live database inspection.

items.title: @shoucccc & @caozlog: Chinese LLM API Routers Leaking Enterprise Credentials
items.body: Security researcher Chaofan Shou revealed a 6TB dataset captured from commercial LLM routers containing active SSH keys, cloud API tokens, and internal prompt logs from Chinese tech leaders and government entities.

items.title: @ClaudeDevs: Anthropic Introduces 'claude plugin eval' for Skill Testing
items.body: Anthropic released 'claude plugin eval' in Claude Code, enabling developers to build benchmark test suites, evaluate custom plugin performance, and compare outputs with and without plugins.

items.title: @vineerpasam & @dirtman: Developers Debate Vibe Coding Reliability & Platform Risk
items.body: Founders and engineers discussed the risks of 'vibe coding' micro-apps when frontier model providers frequently ship native features that displace standalone indie tools overnight.

items.title: @Miulahung: Benchmark Analysis of Token Usage Across GPT-6 Astra Reasoning Levels
items.body: Developer tests comparing GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra reasoning levels found Astra High to be the optimal sweet spot for complex multi-step execution balance.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Apple Paying Samsung $250/Unit for iPhone Duo Foldable OLEDs
items.body: Reports confirmed Apple is sourcing foldable OLED panels from Samsung at $250 per display for the planned iPhone Duo foldable hardware launch.

items.title: @Polymarket: Fields Medalist Deng Yu Vows to Write Romance Novels If AI Solves Math
items.body: Polymarket highlighted Chinese Fields Medal winner Deng Yu's playful claim that he will retire from mathematics to author romance novels if AI models achieve total mathematical problem-solving parity.

items.title: @johnondrasik & @billiewebbb: 25th Anniversary Reflections on 9/11
items.body: Commentators and public figures marked the 25th anniversary of 9/11, reflecting on historical memory, national unity, and long-term cultural impacts.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano & @Bayern_PR: Declan Rice & Anthony Gordon Back Harry Kane for Ballon d'Or
items.body: Declan Rice and Anthony Gordon publicly endorsed Harry Kane for the Ballon d'Or following his record-breaking goal tally at Bayern Munich.

items.title: @ChampionsLeague & @iMiaSanMia: Bayern Munich Extends European Home Record
items.body: UEFA Champions League highlights showcased Michael Olise and Bayern Munich extending their unmatched 39-game home unbeaten run in European competition.

items.title: @SportsCenter: Caitlin Clark Sets Historic WNBA Record
items.body: SportsCenter highlighted Caitlin Clark becoming the first player in WNBA history to log consecutive games with at least 30 points and 10 assists.
